svg.title: Хип-траст в тренажёре — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Lever hip-thrust machine, clear side view. Athlete's shoulder blades rest against a low raised machine back pad, feet flat on the integrated foot platform and knees bent; machine's curved padded lever restraint touches FRONT of hips in both positions and visibly connects to its pivot on the frame. Draw unmistakable integrated machine with frame and footplate and a lever arm, no free barbell. START pelvis dropped well below shoulders, hips flexed. FINISH pelvis lifted, shoulders–hips–knees form near horizontal straight line, shoulders remain against same pad, feet and platform stay in place. Lever follows the hips. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
